name: Don Muang Tollway Public Company Limited
summary: Don Muang Tollway Public Company Limited manages the development and ongoing operation of an elevated toll highway in Thailand under a granted concession. This vital transportation route extends for 21.9 kilometers, linking Din Daeng to the National Memorial Monument. The company provides a full spectrum of services to those utilizing the tollway, encompassing fare collection, traffic oversight, emergency rescue support, and routine maintenance. Established in 1988, Don Muang Tollway Public Company Limited conducts its operations from its primary office located in Bangkok, Thailand.
